                where

                c  ∈ ℤ index

import numpy as np
import scipy
import scipy.linalg
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.integrate import quad, solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import minimize


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, a, b, c):
        a = np.asarray(a, dtype=np.float64)
        assert a.shape == (3,)
        assert np.ndim(b) == 0
        assert np.ndim(c) == 0
        # d = a_b + a_c
        self.d = a[b-1] + a[c]
